name: Pickled rau móp
summary: Pickled rau móp, sour, crisp, and cool, made from the young leaves and tips.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế calls rau móp muối chua a specialty of the district and also pairs it with steamed beef.
howToEat: Eat the pickle. It is also stir-fried with garlic, cooked as sour soup, steamed with chicken, and tossed with chicken, shrimp, or beef, including steamed beef.
seoTitle: Pickled rau móp in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Pickled rau móp, sour, crisp, and cool.
